# OG Preview Checker

> Free Open Graph preview checker: paste a URL and see exactly how the link card will render on Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Slack, and other platforms. Detects missing og: tags, wrong image dimensions, and card-blocking issues.

## Key features

- Real-time OG tag inspection for any public URL
- Social card previews for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Slack, iMessage, Discord
- Image size/dimension validation (og:image best practices)
- Missing-tag detection with fix guidance
- Free to use; no account required
